jp: {voice:00D500}約束の時間、過ぎちゃったね……
en: The appointed time's come and gone...

jp: {voice:00D600}ノルン、{n}お前、見捨てられたな。
en: Norn, looks like they've abandoned you.

jp: {voice:00D700}仕方ない、{n}見せしめに、こいつを城壁に{n}吊し上げるとするか。
en: Can't be helped. Let's string him up on the city wall as an example.

jp: {voice:00D800}ヒィッ！{n}待て、待ってくれ！{n}来るよ、デイヴィドは必ず来る②
en: Eek! Wait, please wait! He'll come, David will definitely come!!

jp: {voice:00D900}ガーロット、もう少し待とう。{n}相手がどんな悪党でも、{n}それは最後の手段にしなきゃ。
en: Garlot, let's wait a little longer. However vile he is, that has to be a last resort.

jp: {voice:00DA00}ガーロット、ジェノン！{n}来たわ。
en: Garlot, Jenon! They're here.

jp: {voice:00DB00}よぉ、また会ったな！{n}大志を抱いた青年達。{n}えーっと、雇い主は無事か？
en: Hey, we meet again, you ambitious youngsters! Now then, is my employer safe?

jp: {voice:00DC00}この通り、ピンピンしてるぜ。{n}もう少し遅ければ、{n}喋れなくなっていたかもな。
en: See for yourself, fit as a fiddle. Any later, and he might not be talking.

jp: {voice:00DD00}デイヴィド！{n}早くこやつ等に金を渡してやれ。
en: David! Hurry up and give these people the money.

jp: {voice:00DE00}解放の条件は手紙に書いた通り、{n}皆から奪った物全てと、{n}金貨３０００枚だ。
en: The terms are as written in the letter: all you took from everyone, plus 3,000 gold coins.

jp: {voice:00DF00}それと、{n}お前ら全員の罪の告白と改心だ。{n}この場で、書面で誓って貰う。
en: And all of you confess your crimes and reform. You'll swear to it here, in writing.

jp: {voice:00E000}最後のには、青臭い与太話として{n}付き合ってやってもいいがよ、{n}お前らに渡す物は何もねぇぜ。
en: I'll humor that last one as your cute little fairy tale, but I've got nothing to hand over to you.

jp: {voice:00E100}どういう事だ？
en: What's that supposed to mean?

jp: {voice:00E200}なぁ、少しは{n}俺達の事も考えてくれよ。
en: C'mon, spare a thought for us too.

jp: {voice:00E300}旦那の財産を渡しちまったら、{n}俺達への支払いがよ、{n}とどこおっちまうだろ？
en: If we give you the boss's fortune, our pay gets held up, right?

jp: {voice:00E400}……約束を破る気か？
en: ...You mean to break the deal?

jp: {voice:00E500}約束なんてした覚えねぇぞ。{n}一方的に言ってきただけだろ。
en: I don't recall making any deal. You just told us your terms.

jp: {voice:00E600}ノルンは解放しないぞ。
en: Then we won't be letting Norn go.

jp: {voice:00E700}実はよ、{n}その方がありがたいんだよね。
en: Thing is, I'd actually prefer that.

jp: {voice:00E800}なんだって？{n}どういうつもりだデイヴィド！{n}命令だ、私を助けろ！
en: What did you say? What's the meaning of this, David?! That's an order, save me!

jp: {voice:00E900}悪りぃな旦那。いやぁ実はよ、{n}旦那は死んじまったと思ってさ、{n}金、結構貰っちゃったんだよね。
en: Sorry, boss. Thing is, y'see, I figured you were dead, so I helped myself to a fair bit of your money.

jp: {voice:00EA00}おい、やれ……
en: Hey, do it...

jp: {voice:00EB00}はい。
en: Yes, sir.

jp: {voice:00EC00}うがぁぁぁぁぁぁぁ！
en: Gyaaaaaaaaah!

jp: {voice:00ED00}あーぁ、{n}ノルンの旦那が、ブレイズ義賊団{n}の伏兵に殺られちまったよ。
en: Aw, too bad. Boss Norn got killed by a Blaze Justice Corps ambush.

jp: {voice:00EE00}デ、デイヴィド…{n}き、き…さま………
en: D-David... you... you...

jp: {voice:00EF00}旦那、安心してください。{n}代金頂いてますからね、アンタの{n}カタキは取りますんで。
en: Don't you worry, boss. I got paid, so I'll get revenge for you.

jp: {voice:00F000}ぐ、うぐぁッ……
en: Gh, ugaah...

jp: {voice:00F100}お、おい…、ノルン！
en: H-hey... Norn!

jp: {voice:00F200}ちょっとなに、信じられない②
en: Wait, what?! I can't believe it!!

jp: {voice:00F300}おいおい、なんだよ……{n}憎いヤツを殺ってやったんだぜ。{n}礼をすべきだろ、ここは。
en: Hey now, what's that look for... I killed a guy you hate. You oughta be thanking me.

jp: {voice:00F400}なんだよこれ。{n}こんな理不尽、許されるのか…
en: What the hell is this? How can something so wrong be allowed...

jp: {voice:00F500}いや、ジェノン、{n}絶対に許される訳はない。{n}奴らを、倒す。
en: No, Jenon, there's no way this gets allowed. We'll take them down.

jp: {voice:00F600}おっ、正義の味方の登場か。{n}いやぁ若さって、本当にいいなぁ。
en: Oh, here come the champions of justice. Ah, being young sure is great.

jp: {voice:00F700}よし、掛かってきな。{n}世の中ってヤツをよ、{n}オメェらに教えてやるぜ。
en: All right, bring it on. I'll teach you kids a thing or two about how the world works.

jp: {voice:00F800}クソっ、ふざけやがって！
en: Damn it, you've got some nerve!

jp: {voice:00F900}ガーロット、冷静に！{n}あと、みんな、わかってるね。{n}ユニオンを有効活用するんだ。
en: Stay calm, Garlot! And everybody, you know the drill. Make good use of the Union.

jp: {voice:00FA00}どうして大人って、{n}自分の事だけしか{n}考えられないワケ……
en: Why can't grown-ups think about anyone but themselves...

jp: {voice:00FB00}やっぱオメェら、そこそこイイ腕{n}してるじゃねぇか。{n}こりゃ将来が楽しみだぜ。
en: Knew it, you kids have some decent skills. I'm looking forward to your future.

jp: {voice:00FC00}そこでだ、どうだろう、{n}オメェらの将来を守る為に、{n}お互い兵を引くって提案はよ？
en: So here's the thing. To protect that future of yours, how about we both pull back?

jp: {voice:00FC00}部下を失ったら、そう来るか。{n}ノルンのカタキとして俺達を、{n}俺達を、倒すんじゃなかったのか？
en: You lose your men, and now this? Weren't you going to take us down, to avenge Norn?

jp: {voice:00FD00}ノルンのカタキとして俺達を、{n}倒すんじゃなかったのか？
en: Weren't you going to take us down, to avenge Norn?

jp: {voice:00FE00}誤解しないで欲しいな、{n}俺は仕事はキッチリやる主義だが{n}オメェらの事、気に入ったんだよ。
en: Don't misunderstand. I'm big on doing my job right, but I've taken a liking to you kids.

jp: {voice:00FF00}お前なんかに！{n}気に入られてたまるか②
en: To the likes of you?! Like I'd want you liking me!!

jp: {voice:000001}世の中の理不尽を無くす為に{n}俺達は戦っているんだ！
en: We're fighting to wipe out the injustice in this world!

jp: {voice:000101}でもよ、この人数が相手だぜ、{n}勝てっこねぇぞ？
en: But look how many of us there are. You can't win, y'know?

jp: {voice:000201}正義が、{n}負けるワケないでしょ！
en: Justice can't possibly lose!

jp: {voice:000301}ああ、{n}例え命を落としたとしても、{n}理想実現の為なら、それでいい。
en: That's right. Even if it costs my life, it's fine, if it's for our ideals.

jp: {voice:000401}イタタタタターッ、{n}そこまで青臭いワケかよ……{n}チッ、ひでぇなオメェらは。
en: Ouch, ouch, ouch! You're THAT green, huh... Tch, you kids are awful.

jp: {voice:000501}あーっ、もう見てられないよ。{n}死んだら理想は語れないだろ、{n}それまでだよ！
en: Ah, geez, I can't watch this anymore. Dead people can't talk about ideals. That's the end of it!

jp: {voice:000601}あぁ？　なんだ、オメェ？
en: Huh? Who the hell are you?

jp: {voice:000701}あたしはメデューテ。{n}旅の武芸者と名乗っておくわ。
en: I'm Medoute. Let's say I'm a traveling warrior.

jp: {voice:000801}生憎、あたしもヤな奴を見ると{n}一発殴ってやりたくなる、{n}青臭い性分なんでね。
en: Too bad for you, I've got a green streak of my own: I see a creep, I want to punch him.

jp: {voice:000901}ブレイズ義賊団と言ったね、{n}加勢させて貰うわよ！
en: Blaze Justice Corps, you said? I'm lending a hand!

jp: {voice:000A01}すごい…、{n}あの大斧を、軽々と振ってる！
en: Amazing... She's swinging that great axe around like it's nothing!

jp: {voice:000B01}こちらの部隊は任せな！{n}あなた達は目前の敵に集中して！
en: Leave these troops to me! You all focus on the enemies in front of you!

jp: {voice:000C01}褐色の肌、長い髪、{n}そしてあの斧さばき。美しい……
en: Dusky skin, long hair, and the way she handles that axe. Beautiful...

jp: {voice:000D01}おい、ガーロット！{n}彼女は誰だ、知り合いなのか？{n}紹介できるのか？
en: Hey, Garlot! Who is she? Do you know her? Can you introduce me?

jp: {voice:000E01}……始まったよ、{n}ジェノンの悪い癖。
en: ...Here we go again, Jenon's bad habit.

jp: {voice:000F01}クソッ、{n}部下を相当失っちまった！
en: Damn it, I've lost way too many men!

jp: {voice:001001}カタル・ブリッジまで撤退だ！{n}態勢を立て直す、兵を纏めろッ！
en: Retreat to Catal Bridge! We'll regroup. Pull the men together!

jp: {voice:001101}デイヴィド隊長！
en: Captain David!

jp: {voice:001201}クソッ、逃がすかよデイヴィド②{n}シスキア、ジェノン、{n}すぐアイツらを追うぞ！
en: Damn it, I won't let you get away, David!! Siskier, Jenon, we're going after them!
...Y-yeah.

jp: {voice:001401}待てって。{n}大した策もなく追っても、{n}結局はまた逃がしちまうよ。
en: Hold it. Chase them without any real plan, and they'll only get away again.

jp: {voice:001501}加勢してくれた事には礼を言う。
en: Thanks for your help.

jp: {voice:001601}だけど、{n}これはアンタには関係の無い{n}戦いだろ、放っておいてくれ。
en: But this fight's got nothing to do with you. Leave us alone.

jp: {voice:001701}呆れた…、よくあなた達、{n}今まで生き抜いてこれたものね。
en: Unbelievable... I'm amazed you've all survived this long.

jp: {voice:001801}正義は負けない、なんて言ってた{n}あなただってそう。
en: That goes for you too, the one saying justice doesn't lose.

jp: {voice:001901}ハイになってるから、{n}そんな心にも無いコトを{n}平気で言えるのよ。
en: You're on a high, so empty words like that come out with no trouble at all.

jp: {voice:001A01}大体、{n}正義の定義って一体なに？
en: For that matter, just what's your definition of justice?

jp: {voice:001B01}そ、それは……
en: W-well, that's...

jp: {voice:001C01}もう一つ聞かせな。{n}あたしが加勢していなければ、{n}どうなってた？
en: One more question. What would have happened if I hadn't stepped in?

jp: {voice:001D01}それは……
en: Well...

jp: {voice:001E01}うん、そうね……{n}もしかしたら、私達、{n}殺されていたかもしれない。
en: Yeah, you're right... We might have gotten killed.

jp: {voice:001F01}ごめん、ガーロット。{n}でも本当にそう思った事だから。
en: Sorry, Garlot. But it's what I honestly thought.

jp: {voice:002001}シスキアの言う通りだ。{n}確かに僕達だけじゃ……
en: Siskier's right. By ourselves, we really...

jp: {voice:002101}俺は、{n}アイツを、アイツを……
en: I... I wanted him, I wanted to...

jp: {voice:002201}理不尽が許せない。{n}納得なんてできない。{n}大いに結構、気持ちもわかる。
en: You can't stand injustice. You can't accept it. Great. I get how you feel.

jp: {voice:002301}だけどね、意思を貫き通すには、{n}強い力と知恵が必要なんだ。{n}それは理解できるよな。
en: But to follow through on your will, you need strength and wisdom. You get that much, right?

jp: {voice:002401}はっきり言うけれど、{n}あなた達の用兵は素人同然。{n}今まではラッキーだっただけ。
en: I'll be frank: your tactics are amateur at best. So far, you've only been lucky.

jp: {voice:002501}そうかもしれない……{n}俺達には、意思を通す力も{n}知恵もない。
en: Maybe so... We don't have the strength or the wisdom to see it through.

jp: {voice:002601}少し、言い過ぎたみたいだな。{n}気を悪くしたのなら、謝る。
en: Guess I went a little too far. If you took offense, I apologize.

jp: {voice:002701}そうそう、ええっとあなた……
en: Oh yeah, and you, um...

jp: {voice:002801}ジェノン、僕はジェノンだ。
en: Jenon. I'm Jenon.

jp: {voice:002901}このブレイズ義賊団を、{n}縁の下で支える参謀であり、{n}戦略と戦術は全て僕が……
en: Tactician and hidden pillar of this Blaze Justice Corps. All strategy and tactics are mine alone to...

jp: {voice:002A01}で、ジュノン君。
en: So, Junon-kun.

jp: {voice:002B01}ジェノンです。
en: It's Jenon.

jp: {voice:002C01}ジェノン君、逃げた敵だけど、{n}カタル・ブリッジに引くって{n}言っていたわよね？
en: Jenon-kun, about those runaways. They said they'd fall back to Catal Bridge, right?

jp: {voice:002D01}奴らが逃げた細い道って、{n}その橋に行く近道？
en: That narrow road they ran down, is that a shortcut to the bridge?

jp: {voice:002E01}いえ、あの道だと大分遠回りに{n}なるはずだけど……
en: No, that road should be a pretty long way around...

jp: {voice:002F01}あたしが奴らなら、{n}橋の近くで隊列を整え、{n}その後で橋を渡るかな？
en: If I were them, I'd regroup near the bridge, then cross it.

jp: {voice:003001}それまでに、追っ手が来なければ{n}少し安心して、油断してるかも{n}しれないな。
en: If no pursuers show by then, they might relax and get careless.

jp: {voice:003101}そうか！{n}先回りして、カタル・ブリッジで{n}待ち伏せをすればいいんだ。
en: That's it! We get ahead of them and lie in wait at Catal Bridge.

jp: {voice:003201}この戦いは、あなた達の戦い。{n}後は自分達で決めるべきだね。
en: This fight is yours. The rest is up to you.

jp: {voice:003301}ただ、その場の気持ちだけで{n}戦ってはダメ。{n}力と知恵を付けなさい。
en: Just don't fight on feelings of the moment. Get some strength and wisdom.

jp: {voice:003401}凄い、凄いですよ！{n}天はあなたに、武と知と美の三つ{n}をお与えになったのですね！
en: Amazing, simply amazing! Heaven has blessed you with the triple gift of arms, wit and beauty!

jp: {voice:003501}あれ、メデューテさん？
en: Huh? Medoute-san?

jp: {voice:003601}相変わらず調子いいわね、{n}ジェノンは。
en: Smooth as ever, aren't you, Jenon?

jp: {voice:003701}あはは、そうか？{n}で、どうする、ガーロット。
en: Ahaha, you think? So, what'll we do, Garlot?

jp: {voice:003801}切り返し早すぎ！
en: That was a fast change of subject!

jp: {voice:003A01}思えば俺は『何とかなる』という{n}根拠のない気持ちだけで、今まで{n}突っ走ってきた。
en: Come to think of it, I've charged ahead all this time on nothing but a groundless "it'll work out somehow."

jp: {voice:003B01}アイツの言う通りだ。
en: She's right.

jp: {voice:003C01}俺は悔しい……{n}俺に、力と知恵を、貸してくれ。
en: It's frustrating... Lend me your strength and your wisdom.

jp: {voice:003D01}ええ。
en: Yeah.

jp: {voice:003E01}もちろんさ、ガーロット。
en: Of course, Garlot.

jp: クッ！{n}…また錬成失敗だ。
en: Ngh! ...Another failed synthesis.

jp: いったい何が足りないんだ。{n}錬成理論は完璧なハズなのに…
en: What on earth is missing? The theory of synthesis should be perfect...

jp: …やはり純正のエレメントが{n}必要なのか…{n}…ブツブツ…
en: ...So it does need pure elements after all... ...mutter, mutter...

jp: ワシはかつて、世界を股にかける{n}冒険者じゃった。
en: In my day, I was an adventurer who roamed the whole wide world.

jp: ワシの夢は今も昔もひとつ！{n}完全なる『世界地図』を{n}完成させるコトじゃ②
en: My dream has always been one thing! To finish a complete 'World Map'!!

jp: まぁ、この老いぼれには{n}見果てぬ夢となったがの。{n}トホホ…
en: Well, for an old coot like me, it's just a dream I'll never reach. Sigh...

jp: …なに？{n}キミ達がその夢を{n}繋いでくれると言うのか？
en: ...What's that? You young folks will carry on that dream for me?

jp: …いや、まだ若いキミ達には{n}キミ達の夢があるはず。{n}気持ちだけで十分じゃよ。
en: ...No, you're young, you must have dreams of your own. The thought alone is plenty.

jp: 話を聞いてくれて{n}ありがとう、若者達。{n}お返しにこれをやろう。
en: Thanks for listening, youngsters. Here, take this in return.

jp: なに、礼ならいらん。{n}キミ達が持つ方が{n}その地図も幸せじゃろう。
en: Eh, no need for thanks. That map'll be happier with you.

jp: キミ達がティエラを離れたら、{n}地理を知る事の重要性が{n}身に染みてくるだろう。
en: Once you leave Tiera, you'll learn just how important it is to know the land.

jp: そのときはきっと、{n}地図がキミ達の力になるはずじゃ。
en: When that time comes, this map's sure to help you out.

jp: ん？{n}なんか落ちてるな…
en: Hm? Something's lying here...

jp: なんだコレ…？{n}子どものオモチャじゃないか。
en: What's this...? Just some kid's toy, isn't it?

jp: ん、これは…
en: Hm, this is...

jp: ああ、最近流行のバッジね。{n}もらっておこうかしら。
en: Oh, it's one of those badges that are all the rage lately. Might as well keep it.

jp: おや？　これは…
en: Oh? What's this...

jp: …僕が身につけるには{n}子ども趣味が過ぎるよね？
en: ...Too childish for me to wear, wouldn't you say?

jp: 何か落ちてるな…
en: Something's lying here...

jp: …勇者バッジ、か。{n}作り物とはいえ、{n}こんなとこで拾うなんてね。
en: ...A Hero Badge, huh. Even if it's a fake, finding one in a place like this...

jp: なんだぁ？{n}部外者が首突っ込むんじゃねぇよ。
en: What's this? Outsiders should keep their noses out of it.

jp: …確かにあたしは部外者ね。
en: ...I suppose I am an outsider.

jp: けれど、あたしは旅人だからね。{n}派閥や徒党に縛られて{n}戦う理由を選んだりはしない。
en: But I'm a traveler, see. I don't tie myself to factions or gangs, or let them pick my reasons to fight.

jp: はいはい、羨ましいねぇ…
en: Yeah, yeah, must be nice...

jp: この女、戦い慣れしてやがる…！
en: This woman knows her way around a fight...!

jp: どうした？{n}余裕が消えたぞ②
en: What's wrong? Where'd all that swagger go!?

jp: ……クソッタレ②{n}今に見ていやがれ！
en: ...Son of a bitch! You just wait!

jp: やるじゃない。{n}傭兵の看板も伊達じゃないな。
en: Not bad. That mercenary sign of yours isn't just for show.

jp: スカしやがって…{n}負けた奴は無様に命乞いでも{n}してりゃあいいんだよ！
en: Acting all cool... Losers oughta just grovel for their lives, nice and pathetic!

jp: …趣味が合わないな。{n}あたしは例え無様だろうが{n}立ち上がる主義なのさ。
en: ...We don't have the same tastes. Me, I make a point of getting back up, pathetic or not.

jp: ブレイズ義賊団
en: Blaze Corps

jp: デイヴィド傭兵団
en: David's Mercs
